epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce system startup time from >10 minutes to <1 minute
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose.yml file, so that the full stack can be launched with a single command
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root without a docker-compose file
When a developer runs docker-compose up
Then the full stack starts successfully
And a health-check endpoint is exposed and returns a 200 OK
slices.tocConstraintRef: Absence of automated local deployment script
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local deployment command count from >5 to 1

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated material retention from >5% to 0%
requirements: R1: Invoke PUT API endpoint to update existing material
R2: Invoke DELETE API endpoint to delete existing material

slices.title: Patch existing UI for material update and delete
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions to the existing material view, so that users can modify the catalog
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system
When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoint
And the catalog view is updated accordingly
slices.tocConstraintRef: Frontend UI missing edit and delete controls
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease user time to update or delete material from >5 mins to <30 seconds

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
epics.tocConstraintRef: System security and access control bottleneck
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in

slices.title: Patch security layer for authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing the authentication mechanism for this epic, I want to add session validation, so that unauthorized access to epidemiological materials is prevented
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material
Then they are blocked from accessing the resource
And they are prompted to log in
slices.tocConstraintRef: Missing session validation logic in access layer
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase authenticated request coverage from 0% to 100% on protected routes
